title: Purchase Cycle: Order → Receipt → Bill → Payment
intro:
भाग 4 — Trading का पूरा चक्र

कुल Problems: 4 │ 🟢 1 🟡 2 🔴 1

🎯 इस Chapter में आप सीखेंगे

Purchase Order से Receipt Note, Bill और Rejection Out तक पूरा Cycle चलाना।

🧭 Tally में रास्ता (Steps)

F11 में Order Processing = Yes

Purchase Order (Alt+F4) → Receipt Note (Alt+F9) → Purchase Bill (F9)

खराब माल पर Rejection Out (Ctrl+F5)

⚠️ आम गलतियाँ

Bill में Order का Reference न चुनना — Pending Order खुला रहता है

Receipt Note के बिना Bill बनाना

📌 ज़रूरी नोट

Purchase Order (Alt+F4), Receipt Note (Alt+F9), Purchase Bill (F9) व Rejection Out (Ctrl+F5) का प्रयोग करें; पहले F10 दबाकर ये Voucher Types Activate करें। हर Order में Order No. व Tracking No. भरें। हर तारीख़ 1st/2nd/Last Date, FY है।

📘 Practice Problems

हर Problem में करना है: Pass the full Purchase Order → Receipt Note → Purchase Bill → Rejection Out cycle in Tally Prime and check Purchase Bill Pending / Purchase Order Outstanding reports.
guide:
Purchase Cycle: Order → Receipt → Bill → Payment

हर Problem: क्या करना है → Steps → Entry Table → ✅ Check (उत्तर-कुंजी से मिलान)।

सबसे पहले — Purchase Cycle के Steps

  • F11 (Features) → Order Processing = Yes।
  • Voucher Types को Activate करें (F10 से), फिर चारों Voucher तैयार रहेंगे।
  • Purchase Order: Alt+F4 → Party, Order No., Due Date, Items और Rate।
  • Receipt Note: Alt+F9 → Party चुनें, Tracking No. डालें, Order का Reference चुनें (Against Order)।
  • Purchase Bill: F9 → Receipt Note का Reference चुनें (Against Receipt Note)। Quantity वही जो Bill में आई।
  • खराब/गलत माल लौटाना हो तो Rejection Out (Ctrl+F5)।
  • Payment: Payment Voucher (F5) में Agst Ref चुनकर भुगतान करें।
याद रखें

Purchase Order और Receipt Note का Accounts पर असर नहीं; असर Purchase Bill से आता है।

Order का Reference न चुनने पर Pending Order खुला रह जाता है।

Reports: Display More Reports → Statements of Inventory → Purchase Order Outstanding / Purchase Bills Pending।

Pre-Close कैसे करें

जो Quantity अब नहीं आएगी, उसे Order में "Close/Pre-Close" करें (Order Outstanding Report या Voucher की Order Details में यह विकल्प मिलता है)।

विकल्प का नाम Tally के Version के अनुसार थोड़ा अलग दिख सकता है।

problems.title: Pritam Garments — Basic Purchase Order Cycle
problems.q:
🟢 Basic

  • 1st April — Pritam Garments sent Purchase Order (No. Ram-001) to Mr. Ramniwas: 50 Pcs Shirt 40" @ ₹250; 70 Pcs Shirt 42" @ ₹280
  • 2nd April — Goods received against Ram-001 (Receipt Note): Shirt 40" — 50 Pcs (Full); Shirt 42" — 60 Pcs (10 Pcs Short due to material issue)
  • 2nd April — Purchase Bill raised against the Receipt Note: Shirt 40" — 30 Pcs; Shirt 42" — 40 Pcs
  • 2nd April — 5 Pcs Shirt 40" returned to supplier due to size issue (Rejection Out)
problems.hint:
• 1 Apr: Purchase Order (Ram-001) — Mr. Ramniwas: Shirt 40" 50 @ 250; Shirt 42" 70 @ 280।

  • 2 Apr: Purchase Bill (Against Receipt Note): Shirt 40" 30 और Shirt 42" 40।
  • 2 Apr: Rejection Out: Shirt 40" 5 Pcs (Size Issue)।

problems.title: Mahalaxmi Fire-Works — Two Orders, One Receipt, Partial Billing
problems.q:
🟡 Intermediate

Opening Balances — Cash ₹ 1,00,000; HDFC Bank ₹ 80,000

  • 1st April — Purchase Order (Heera-001, due 1st May) to Heera Fire-Works: 200 Packet Anar Bomb @ ₹250; 300 Packet Rocket @ ₹200; 250 Packet Chakra @ ₹300
  • 2nd April — Purchase Order (Heera-002, due 1st May) to Heera Fire-Works: 100 Packet Baby Gun-6 Shot @ ₹90; 50 Packet Flower Cracker @ ₹60
  • 1st May — Receipt Note against both orders (Tracking No. 1): Anar Bomb 200; Rocket 250; Chakra 200; Baby Gun 80; Flower Cracker 50 (Packets). Pre-Close all pending Baby Gun quantity
  • 1st May — Purchase Bill against Receipt Note 1: Anar Bomb — half of received quantity; Rocket 150; Chakra 100; Baby Gun 50; Flower Cracker 50. Paid ₹ 42,500 to Heera Fire-Works by cheque
  • 2nd May — 30 Packet Baby Gun returned to Heera Fire-Works (Reason: Out of Order) — Rejection Out

  • 1 Apr: PO Heera-001 (Due 1 May): Anar Bomb 200 @ 250; Rocket 300 @ 200; Chakra 250 @ 300। 2 Apr: PO Heera-002: Baby Gun 100 @ 90; Flower Cracker 50 @ 60।
  • 1 May: एक Receipt Note (Tracking No. 1) दोनों Orders के विरुद्ध: Anar 200; Rocket 250; Chakra 200; Baby Gun 80; Flower 50। Baby Gun की बाकी 20 Packet Pre-Close करें।
